text: Decimal Fractional American Conversion Table total payout per unit staked, including original stake. decimal odds 2.50 means 1 unit stake returns 2.50 units bet wins (1 unit profit + 1 unit stake). Standard Europe Australia. Example: Decimal 2.50 10 unit stake pays 25 units (15 profit). Expresses profit relative stake fraction. Traditional UK format. “3/2” (read “three two”) means 3 units profit every 2 units staked. Conversion: Decimal = (numerator / denominator) + 1 Example: 3/2 fractional = 2.50 decimal Positive numbers show profit 100 unit stake; negative numbers show stake needed win 100 units. Standard United States. +150 means bet 100 win 150 profit -200 means bet 200 win 100 profit Conversion: Positive: Decimal = (American / 100) + 1 Negative: Decimal = (100 / |American|) + 1
